title: Recycle Armors
description: You can recycle armors! Example: A diamond chestplate = eight diamonds!
body: YOU CAN RECYCLE ALL OF THE ARMORS! Example: A diamond armor = eight diamonds! (Please place the armor middle place of the crafting table!) PLEASE RECYCLE! !Armors can feel! You can recycle looted armors! (!ARMORS CAN FEEL!)
